edits.text: The input is the finished photograph with a rough render of one walnut bench and its soft contact shadow pasted in front of the limestone panel: that pasted area is the mask. Keep the bench's outline, position and size exactly as pasted; only make it real.
edits.why: var2 takes no mask: the mask is the pasted clay area of the input, as in D0o (2026-11-17); the designer text itself is unchanged
